title: First round exit time
statement: For a compiled-machine configuration $d$ on a Boolean input word $x$, define its round time to be the least positive integer $t$ for which the round machine started at $d$ is in one of the two designated exit states after $t$ steps, if such a time exists; if no such positive time exists, set the round time to zero.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a compiled-machine configuration with $k+2$ work tapes on input $x$
caveat: The snippet does not define the round machine or the two designated exit states.
